title: Development / Redevelopment of Housing Schemes of MHADA
scope: MHADA-owned or MHADA-managed housing schemes (EWS/LIG/MIG). Covers both new schemes on vacant MHADA land and redevelopment of existing MHADA colonies.

categories.HIG: High Income Group (NOT eligible for 4.0 FSI)

new_scheme_on_vacant_mhada_land.note: FSI 4.0 not applicable to HIG portion.

rehab_area_entitlement.max_cap: Cannot exceed max MIG carpet area prescribed by Govt on date of approval

incentive_fsi.definition: Additional FSI over-and-above rehab FSI, as % of admissible rehab area
incentive_fsi.LR: Land Rate for FSI 1 per ASR (weighted avg if multiple rates apply)
incentive_fsi.RC: Rate of RCC Construction per ASR
incentive_fsi.year_used: Year in which redevelopment project is approved by Competent Authority
incentive_fsi.subject_to: Availability of FSI on plot under redevelopment and MHADA's distribution decision

balance_fsi_sharing.description: FSI remaining after rehab + incentive is shared between Co-op Society and MHADA. MHADA's share is handed over FREE of cost.

special_case_plots_up_to_2000_sqm.option: MHADA may waive its BUA share and instead allow additional BUA up to 3.00 FSI on payment of premium per Table C1

plots_4000_sqm_plus_and_road_18m_plus.handover_cost: MHADA pays cost of construction as per ASR; no compensation for BUA

development_cess_infrastructure.applies_to: BUA over Zonal (basic) FSI, including fungible
development_cess_infrastructure.shared_with_mcgm_note_alt: 5/7th part (~71%) — DCPR text has both formulations

premium_exemptions_no_31_1_and_31_3: Construction of EWS/LIG/MIG tenements by MHADA on MHADA plot
EWS/LIG/MIG tenements towards MHADA's share in redevelopment
Rehabilitation component of a redevelopment project

consent_requirement.mhada_undertaken_case: Co-op Society resolution per Cooperative Societies Act 1960 is sufficient

corpus_fund.purpose: Maintenance of new rehab buildings, held with Co-op Housing Society

excluded: Land under reservation of public amenities

convenience_shopping.note: Original DCPR text 12m minimum; revised to 9m

slum_pocket_within_mhada_layout.trigger: Land partially occupied by slum notified under Slum Act Sec 4 prior to 1/1/2000 (or such reference date)

cross_references.reg_31_fungible: Fungible on rehab and MHADA share: free of premium (no Reg 31(1)/31(3) charge)
cross_references.reg_33_10_borrowed_relaxations: Reg 33(10) relaxations apply here EXCEPT clauses 6.11, 6.15, 6.16, 6.18
cross_references.reg_17_1: Reservations in MHADA layout developed per Reg 17(1)

operational_formulas_verified.description: Verified against Worli MHADA feasibility (Shivneri CHS 1&2 + Shree Ganesh 3&4, plot 4,381.35 sqm, 192 tenants, SDRR ₹1,78,070/sqm). Basic FSI 3.0 → 13,144.05 sqm; Full scheme with fungible 5.4 FSI → 23,659.29 sqm.

basic_fsi_selection.verified_worli: plot 4,381.35 (>4000) qualifies for 4.0; feasibility achieves 4.0 base + 35% fungible = 5.4 total FSI

rehabilitation_entitlement_formula.cap: max entitlement ≤ MIG carpet limit prescribed by Govt on approval date

operational_formulas_verified.basic_ratio_formula: LR / RC where LR = ASR land rate per sqm, RC = ASR RCC construction rate per sqm (both for approval year)

development_cess.applies_to: Extra FSI (excl. fungible) over normal FSI
development_cess.mcgm_share_ratio: 5/7 to MCGM off-site infra, 2/7 retained by MHADA

extraction_gaps.note: MIG carpet cap value referenced 'as prescribed by Govt' — resolved via Govt notification. Basic Ratio requires ASR data — user inputs LR & RC directly.
extraction_gaps.calculator_status: AVAILABLE — Reg33_5_Calculator.php present. Verified structurally against Worli MHADA (plot × Basic FSI 3.0 and full-scheme 5.4).
